summary: Many times the MoFo sites built on React are unreadable to me. This a trodden path when @mozilla adopts framework du juor and then the person who liked that framework leaves and then the projects dies. Plus is React a W3C standard or does it use made up javascript?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Many times the MoFo sites built on React are unreadable to me.

This a trodden path when @mozilla adopts framework du juor and then the person who liked that framework leaves and then the projects dies.

Plus is React a W3C standard or does it use made up javascript?
